definitions.explanation: A snake that produces venom and can deliver it through a bite. In Japan, common venomous snakes include the mamushi (pit viper) and habu.

examples.japanese: {毒蛇|どくへび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧。
⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{毒蛇|どくへび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{噛|か}まれた→噛む：01205_kamu⟧。
examples.english: I was bitten by a venomous snake on the mountain trail.

examples.japanese: マムシ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{身近|みぢか}→身近：03157_mijika⟧な{毒蛇|どくへび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ひとつだ。
examples.english: The mamushi is one of the most commonly encountered venomous snakes in Japan.

notes:
Also read as どく⟦じゃ→じゃ：03040_ja⟧, though どくへび is the more common reading in everyday speech. Strictly speaking, 'venomous' (injecting toxin via bite) is more accurate than 'poisonous' (toxic when ingested), but {毒蛇|どくへび} covers both in Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毒蛇|どくへび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{噛|か}まれる→噛む：01205_kamu⟧: to be bitten by a venomous snake
- {毒蛇|どくへび}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧: snake venom
- {毒蛇|どくへび}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注意|ちゅうい}→注意：01464_chuui⟧: warning about venomous snakes

RELATED WORDS:
- マムシ: Japanese pit viper — the most common venomous snake in mainland Japan
- ⟦ハブ→ハブ：11589_habu⟧: habu — a large venomous pit viper found in Okinawa
- ⟦{蛇|へび}→蛇：02246_hebi⟧: snake — the general term
- ⟦{毒|どく}→毒：10052_doku⟧: poison, venom
